title: The id and object shape of an AppPassword over JMAP, which the design note does not specify
description:
docs/design/frontend-auth.md §3.6 names AppPassword/get and AppPassword/set and says the response carries the secret once, and nothing else. INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC, chosen in bead mimid-e13m.6 (crates/mimid-agent/src/app_password.rs, whose rustdoc carries the table):

- The id is `c` and the row's integer id. Integer ids are never reused, so the id stays unique after a name is given to another credential; the name alone would collide, because a revoked row is kept 30 days (§3.1).
- The object is one row of the credential table as the CLI and /msg mimid passwords show it: id, name, kind, createdAt, createdBy, lastUsedAt, lastUsedBy, revokedAt. Never a secret and never a verifier.
- create takes only name; the agent makes the secret, which appears once as `secret` on the created object.
- update is forbidden: no property is writable. destroy revokes.
- state is a digest of the listing with the last use left OUT, so a login does not look like a change to every other client.
- Revoked rows are listed, as the CLI lists them, so a client can show that a device was revoked.
close_reason: Decided and recorded; implemented in bead mimid-e13m.6.
